# Item Filter
if filters.get("item_code"):
    conditions.append("poi.item_code = %(item_code)s")
    values["item_code"] = filters.get("item_code")

where_clause = ""

    SELECT
        poi.parent AS purchase_order,
        po.transaction_date AS po_date,
        po.supplier_name AS supplier_name,
        poi.project AS project,
        poi.item_code AS item_code,
        poi.item_name AS item_name,
        poi.qty AS po_qty,

        IFNULL(SUM(pri.qty), 0) AS grn_qty,

        (poi.qty - IFNULL(SUM(pri.qty), 0)) AS balance_qty,

        CASE
            WHEN IFNULL(SUM(pri.qty), 0) > poi.qty
            THEN (IFNULL(SUM(pri.qty), 0) - poi.qty)
            ELSE 0
        END AS excess_qty,

        IFNULL(SUM(pri.rejected_qty), 0) AS rejected_qty,

        poi.rate AS rate,
        poi.amount AS total_amount

        AND pri.docstatus = 1

    data = columns, results
else:
    exists = frappe.db.sql("""
        SELECT name FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
        WHERE item_code = %s
          AND is_cancelled = 0
        LIMIT 1
    """, (item_code))

    if not exists:
        frappe.msgprint("No stock movement found for this item")
        data = columns, results
    else:
        item_name = frappe.db.get_value("Item", item_code, "item_name")

        # =========================
        # Opening Qty
        # Priority 1: Latest submitted Stock Reconciliation before from_date
        # Priority 2: qty_after_transaction from last valid SLE before from_date
        # =========================
        opening_qty = 0

        stock_reco_qty = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT sri.qty
            FROM `tabStock Reconciliation Item` sri
            INNER JOIN `tabStock Reconciliation` sr ON sr.name = sri.parent
            WHERE sri.item_code = %s
              AND sr.posting_date <= %s
              AND sr.docstatus = 1
            ORDER BY sr.posting_date DESC, sr.creation DESC
            LIMIT 1
        """, (item_code, from_date))

        if stock_reco_qty:
            opening_qty = float(stock_reco_qty[0][0] or 0)
        else:
            last_sle = frappe.db.sql("""
                SELECT qty_after_transaction
                FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
                WHERE item_code = %s
                  AND posting_date < %s
                  AND docstatus = 1
                  AND is_cancelled = 0
                ORDER BY posting_date DESC, creation DESC
                LIMIT 1
            """, (item_code, from_date))

            opening_qty = float(last_sle[0][0] or 0) if last_sle else 0

        # =========================
        # Transactions
        # =========================
        sle = frappe.db.sql("""
            SELECT voucher_no, posting_date, actual_qty
            FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
            WHERE item_code = %s
              AND posting_date BETWEEN %s AND %s
              AND docstatus = 1
              AND is_cancelled = 0
            ORDER BY posting_date ASC, creation ASC
        """, (item_code, from_date, to_date), as_dict=True)

        balance       = opening_qty
        total_receipt = 0
        total_issue   = 0

        # Opening Row
        results.append({
            "receipt":      "Opening",
            "posting_date": from_date,
            "qty":          opening_qty,
            "receipt_qty":  None,
            "issue_qty":    None,
            "balance_qty":  balance,
            "item_name":    item_name
        })

        for row in sle:
            actual      = float(row.actual_qty or 0)
            receipt_qty = actual if actual > 0 else 0
            issue_qty   = abs(actual) if actual < 0 else 0
            balance    += actual
            total_receipt += receipt_qty
            total_issue   += issue_qty

            results.append({
                "receipt":      row.voucher_no,

""", {"parents": tuple(included_parents)}, as_dict=True)

all_included = ["__none__"]
if parent_ranges:
    range_conditions = " OR ".join(
        f"(lft >= {r.lft} AND rgt <= {r.rgt})" for r in parent_ranges
    )
    included_rows = frappe.db.sql(f"""
        SELECT name FROM `tabItem Group`
        WHERE {range_conditions}
    """, as_dict=True)
    all_included = [row.name for row in included_rows] or ["__none__"]

# 3. Item filter conditions
item_conditions = "i.disabled = 0 AND i.item_group IN %(included_groups)s"
if item_head:
    item_conditions += " AND i.item_group = %(item_head)s"

# 4. Main SQL
result = frappe.db.sql(f"""
    SELECT * FROM (
        SELECT
            i.item_code,
            i.item_name,
            i.item_group,
            i.stock_uom AS unit,
            IFNULL(opening.open_qty, 0)         AS open_qty,
            IFNULL(period_data.receipt_qty, 0)  AS receipts,
            IFNULL(period_data.issue_qty, 0)    AS issued,
            (
                IFNULL(opening.open_qty, 0)
                + IFNULL(period_data.receipt_qty, 0)
                - IFNULL(period_data.issue_qty, 0)
            ) AS stock

        FROM `tabItem` i

        /* ── FIXED Opening ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────
           Last qty_after_transaction per (item, warehouse) before from_date,
           summed across all warehouses for company-wide opening balance.
           More accurate than SUM(actual_qty) — handles same-day multi-entry edge cases.
        ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT item_code, SUM(qty_after_transaction) AS open_qty
            FROM (
                SELECT
                    item_code,
                    warehouse,
                    qty_after_transaction,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (
                        PARTITION BY item_code, warehouse
                        ORDER BY posting_date DESC, posting_time DESC, creation DESC
                    ) AS rn
                FROM `tabStock Ledger Entry`
                WHERE
                    posting_date <= %(from_date)s
                    AND company      = %(company)s
                    AND is_cancelled = 0
            ) last_per_warehouse
            WHERE rn = 1
            GROUP BY item_code
        ) opening ON opening.item_code = i.item_code

        /* ── FIXED Period Data ──────────────────────────────────────────────────
           Excludes internal warehouse-to-warehouse transfers to prevent
           double-counting (both positive and negative SLE rows for same item).
        ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────── */
        LEFT JOIN (
            SELECT
                sle.item_code,
                SUM(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty > 0 THEN  sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END) AS receipt_qty,
                SUM(CASE WHEN sle.actual_qty < 0 THEN -sle.actual_qty ELSE 0 END) AS issue_qty

        OR summary.receipts != 0
        OR summary.issued   != 0
    )
